title: Scamorza Pasta Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired stir fry made with scamorza cheese and served with a side of pasta, blending earthy and creamy flavors.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add diced scamorza cheese and cook until it starts to melt and form a golden crust.
Add sliced mushrooms, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt. Stir fry for 3-4 minutes or until the mushrooms are tender.
Add cooked pasta to the skillet and stir to combine with the mushroom and cheese mixture.
Season with a pinch of black pepper and serve hot.
Optional: Add some chopped scallions on top for garnish.
